source.title_on_document: Autonomous language-image generation loops converge to generic visual motifs

paper_design_summary: A model-only simulation with no human participants. The authors run closed loops in which SDXL generates an image from a text prompt and LLaVA describes the image in 50 words or fewer, and the description becomes the next prompt; 700 trajectories (100 novelty-search starting prompts x 7 LLaVA temperatures) run for 100 iterations each, plus 16 generator-captioner combinations x 40 trajectories. Semantic drift and convergence are measured with cosine distances between all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings of the prompts and with k-means clustering of the final prompts.

studies.label: AI-to-AI text-image-text loops (temperature experiment and model-combination experiment)

participants.who: No human participants. The units are model-generated trajectories: 700 trajectories in the temperature experiment and 40 trajectories per generator-captioner combination in the model-combination experiment.
participants.quote: experiments were conducted across seven temperature values: 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, and 1.3. Each trajectory evolved through 100 prompt-image-prompt cycles.
participants.locator: printed p. 10 (PDF p. 11), Methods, Iterative language-image loop construction

ai_tool.name_model: SDXL (stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0) with LLaVA (llava:13b); robustness with segmind-SSD-1B, stable-diffusion-v1.5, playground-v2-aesthetic and bakllava, llava:13b-v1.6, moondream; initial prompts from LLaMA 3.2
ai_tool.how_used: Models only; no person used AI.

task.description: Autonomous loop: describe an image in vivid, artistic terms (50 words or fewer), regenerate an image from the description, repeat for 100 iterations.

company_involvement.description: Declaration of interests: the authors declare no competing interests. Computation supported by the Institute for Cyber-Enabled Research at Michigan State University.
company_involvement.locator: printed p. 11 (PDF p. 12), Acknowledgments and Declaration of interests

eligibility.reason: Model-only study with no human participants: two AI models (SDXL and LLaVA) iterate on each other's outputs without human input (printed p. 1, PDF p. 2, Summary; printed p. 10, PDF p. 11, Methods). No person is assigned to AI, and no human-produced output is compared with AI output, so it is neither core nor ai_vs_human context. The codebook lists model-only studies in the screening report and omits them from the dataset.

one_line_finding: In 700 autonomous SDXL-LLaVA loops run for 100 iterations, final prompts fell into k = 12 clusters when pooled across seven temperatures (k = 14 to 19 per temperature in the Figure 5 legend), which the authors call convergence to generic 'visual elevator music' (printed pp. 3-4, Figure 5 on printed p. 7).
notes: Printed page numbers run 1-12; the PDF has a cover page, so PDF page = printed page + 1. Figure 5 legend gives per-temperature k_opt values of 16, 18, 19, 14, 16, 17, 17 (printed p. 7); the text says 'ranging from 15 to 20' and 'k = 16 for T = 0.1 and k = 14 for T = 0.7' (printed p. 3), a small text-figure inconsistency. Model-combination ANOVA: language model F = 33.242, p < 10^-19; image generator F = 0.534, p = 0.659 (Table 1, printed p. 10). These are model-only results with no bearing on the three questions.
